text: Under Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) Policy Resolution 2-2 - Annual Review of Parking Rates, the TPA reviews and sets rates at its off-street parking facilities. TPA staff are recommending that Policy Resolution 2-2 be amended to state that the annual parking rate review will be carried out in coordination with the annual capital budget process. A number of housekeeping changes are also proposed.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the amendments to Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 2-2 - Annual Review of Parking Rates in Appendix A to the report (January 21, 2020) from the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, and directed the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to enact this Policy Resolution, as amended.
